name: Competitor Analysis
description: Research competitors, identify positioning gaps, and produce an action-ready opportunity report.
purpose: Give ZED a repeatable research flow for market, audience, content, and competitor intelligence.

stages.name: Market Scan
stages.description: Collect competitor positioning, visible offers, content angles, and audience signals.

steps.label: Identify direct and adjacent competitors from the context.
Map competitor offers, audience promises, and pricing signals when available.
Detect repeated positioning, content, and product patterns.

stages.name: Gap Analysis
stages.description: Find content gaps, offer gaps, and weak points in competitor execution.

steps.label: Identify offer, pricing, or product gaps.
Rank opportunities by speed, cost, and expected leverage.

stages.name: Action Memo
stages.description: Produce a concise next-move memo with risks and recommended execution steps.

steps.label: Convert the recommendation into next tasks.

userFacingBlurb: Find market gaps, weak competitor moves, and the best next opportunity.
